recipe: Sesame-peanut noodles with crisp chilli CHICKEN
servesNote: 2½ portions, split 3:2 — Karl 910 kcal / 59 g protein, Maria 607 kcal / 39 g protein. ⚠️ A SIBLING of the tofu-crumble version, not a replacement: that row stays live and stays the vegan option.
adaptations: ⛔ THE TOASTED SESAME OIL IS OUT, and step 4 exists only to add it. Without it this is a peanut noodle bowl — still good, but the sesame is what the dish is named for and there is no substitute that behaves the same way off the heat.

⚠️ SOY IS DOWN TO 4 SACHETS AND THERE IS NO BOTTLE, and PEANUT BUTTER IS LOW — one 340 g Meridian jar. Both are in the sauce, so check them before you start rather than halfway through letting the paste down.
⚠️ EGG NOODLES ARE DOWN TO ABOUT A THIRD OF A 250 g PACKET. Tuesday bought no noodles. Fusilli will carry the sauce if it comes to it, though it is not the same bowl.

⭐ WHY THIS DISH EXISTS, AND IT IS WORTH KNOWING: created 30 Aug when Karl asked for a meat version. The knock-on was better than the change — it pushed the veg traybake to Wednesday, put chicken on the afternoon it is bought (the lowest-risk cook available), kept fish on day 1 after the shop, and cut the week's protein overshoot from +12.4% to +8.2%.

ingredients.prep: ⛔ ONE UNCROWDED LAYER, or two batches
⭐ half in at assembly, half over at the end
⭐ let down ONE tablespoon of water at a time
⛔ out of stock — and it goes in OFF the heat
⛔ drained and rinsed COLD until no longer slippery
high heat, and very little of it
at the table, not in the pan

equipment.item: 🔴 REQUIRED — the widest pan you own
equipment.why: diced chicken in a crowded pan releases water and boils instead of catching. One uncrowded layer, or two batches

equipment.item: 🔴 REQUIRED — a mixing bowl and spoon
equipment.why: ⭐ for letting the peanut butter down, used BEFORE anything goes in the pan

equipment.item: 🔴 REQUIRED — a colander in the sink and the cold tap

equipment.why: ⭐ sauce underneath, noodles on top, tossed up from the base at the table

prep: ⭐ MIXING BOWL, SPOON — and this happens BEFORE anything goes in the pan. Peanut butter, then soy. Let it down one tablespoon of water at a time until it pours like double cream. Chilli flakes, lemon. Set aside.

steps.text: Pan of water. Noodles to the packet, then ⛔ drained and rinsed COLD until no longer slippery. Leave to drain hard.
Widest pan, high heat, barely any oil. Diced chicken in one layer. ⛔ Leave it alone until the pieces release and the undersides have browned and crisped at the corners.
Off the heat for a moment. Rice wine in, scrape the base while it bubbles.
⭐ Off the heat. Sesame oil now — never over heat.
Serving bowl. Sauce underneath, noodles on top, then chicken, cucumber, half the spring onions. Toss up from the base at the table.
Remaining spring onions and crushed peanuts over. ⭐ Let it sit until no more than warm. Sriracha at the table.
